report.summary: Section 12 forbids many patterns, but the document elsewhere lacks definitions for 'canonical contracts', 'marginal evidence', and 'falsification experiment', making enforcement impossible.
risks: 12.1 | high | 'new public mythological subsystems or parallel control planes' is forbidden, but the document does not define 'mythological subsystems' or 'parallel control planes', so the rule is ambiguous | Attempt to identify any subsystem as mythological; if no clear criteria exist, the rule is unfalsifiable.

12.2 | high | 'direct legacy-to-legacy wiring that bypasses canonical contracts' is forbidden, but the document does not define 'canonical contracts' elsewhere | Search the document for 'canonical contracts'; if absent, the prohibition is unenforceable.

12.3 | high | 'a universal graph score, diffusion number, or “intelligence” scalar' is forbidden, but the document elsewhere (e.g., section X) may implicitly require such a scalar for promotion decisions | Check all sections referencing promotion or scoring; if any require a scalar, contradiction.

12.4 | medium | 'an unbounded AST hairball or a fifth AST graph' is forbidden, but the document does not define 'AST hairball' or specify how many AST graphs exist | Count the AST graphs defined elsewhere; if four are defined, the rule is clear; if not, unclear.

12.5 | medium | 'chat transcripts as orchestration state' is forbidden, but the document may elsewhere require state that could only be implemented via chat transcripts | Look for any state requirement that implies sequential conversation logs.

12.6 | medium | 'shared mutable memory for product personalization and research adaptation' is forbidden, but the document elsewhere may require personalization that implies shared mutable state | Check personalization requirements; if they need mutable shared state, contradiction.

12.7 | high | 'an LLM judgment as a hard correctness or promotion gate' is forbidden, but the document elsewhere may define promotion criteria that rely on LLM evaluation | Check promotion gate definitions; if any use LLM judgment as a gate, contradiction.

12.8 | medium | 'simultaneous unregistered co-evolution of code, prompts, evaluators, and policy' is forbidden, but the document elsewhere may allow unregistered evolution in some contexts | Check versioning/registration requirements; if any allow unregistered changes, contradiction.

12.9 | medium | 'automatic merge/promotion or candidate access to its evaluator' is forbidden, but the document elsewhere may require automatic promotion for some candidates | Check promotion rules; if automatic promotion is required for any candidate, contradiction.

12.10 | low | 'a marketing clone whose comparison protocol is not reproducible' is forbidden, but the document does not define 'marketing clone' or 'comparison protocol' | Search for these terms; if undefined, the rule is ambiguous.

12.11 | high | 'new graph planes without demonstrated marginal evidence' is forbidden, but the document does not define 'marginal evidence' or specify what constitutes demonstration | Look for definitions of 'marginal evidence'; if absent, the rule is unenforceable.

12.12 | high | The exception 'isolated falsification experiment with an explicit hypothesis and no production promotion' lacks definition of 'falsification experiment' and 'explicit hypothesis' elsewhere in the document | Search for these terms; if undefined, the exception is meaningless.
todos: Define 'canonical contracts' in a foundational section before referencing them in prohibitions.
Define 'marginal evidence' and specify what counts as demonstration.
Define 'falsification experiment' and 'explicit hypothesis' to make the exception operational.
Resolve any contradictions between forbidden patterns and required behaviors in other sections.
Ensure all terms used in prohibitions are defined elsewhere in the document.
